fusions.name: Trampled Banquet
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. If it hits, your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Straggler's Portion
fusions.desc: Stamps down on a target at or below 30% health, dealing 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Trail Rations
fusions.desc: You regain 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed on the March
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
